content:
**Red Rocket** is an unmarked location in the Burning Springs region of Appalachia.

A fortified Red Rocket gas station at The Chop Shop, along Route 7.

Behind the counter is a Stash Box, the southern room next to it has terminal and a wall safe. The garage is only accessible from the outside, and has a Weapons Workbench. On the roof is a radio post with a Ham Radio. A Legendary Glowing Wendigo may be found here.

Two Abraxodyne Intel, one under the counter, and one in the bloodied garage.

Intel
